attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across the 3-node Alpine cluster: node1 is the writable primary, node2 and node3 are read-only standbys using physical replication slots. Verified writes on node1 propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for all three nodes, proving changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery (services auto-started, replication reconnected, data intact) at each step.
